domainSeparator().details: Recomputed after a chain split rather than cached blindly. A      signature is scoped to one chain id and one contract address, so a      verdict signed for the testnet deployment cannot be replayed onto      mainnet — which a bare digest over the tuple would permit.

getBandedPrice(string).details: Integer arithmetic throughout. In floating point,      `100 * (1 + 50/10_000)` is 100.49999999999999, so a print landing      exactly on a band edge scores as outside it. Those cases are rare      but not random — they cluster where the band is doing its work.

params.allowedFlags: Bits the caller has decided it understands. Any flag        outside this mask reverts, and the revert names the offenders.

params.signatures: Distinct allow-listed signers, sorted ascending by        recovered address. Sorting is how distinctness is proved in O(n)        without a memory set.

postVerdicts(string[],(uint128,uint64,ui.details: A failed item is recorded and skipped, never thrown. Anyone may      relay and the contract rejects anything not strictly newer, so two      relayers racing on one ticker is an ordinary event. Bubbling that      revert would discard the other items and burn the gas anyway.      Landing every instrument in one block also matters more than the      gas: posted separately they land across many, and a consumer      reading mid-round gets a snapshot that never existed at any instant.

transferOwnership(address).details: Two steps, because the owner is the only address that can rotate a      compromised signer or raise the threshold. A single-step transfer      to a mistyped address destroys both powers permanently, and the      contract's whole claim is that the threshold is a parameter rather      than a redeploy. A zero check alone still lets a typo win.

MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_SEC().notice: How far ahead of the chain's clock a verdict may claim to be.

getBandedPrice(string).notice: Band edges, computed the same way off chain.

getPriceIfSafe(string,uint64).notice: The default read: refuses anything that is not a clean live print.

getPriceIfSafe(string,uint64,uint16).notice: Read a price, opting into named risks.

needsUpdate(string[],uint64).notice: Batch staleness discovery, for keepers. View, so asking is free.

postVerdict(string,(uint128,uint64,uint6.notice: Post a verdict. Anyone may relay; the contract authenticates the         signatures, not the sender.

postVerdicts(string[],(uint128,uint64,ui.notice: Post several verdicts in one transaction.

threshold().notice: How many distinct allow-listed signatures a verdict needs.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Offer ownership. The recipient must accept it.
